messages:
Evan (AM): AcmeBank POC hitting two issues: missing trace IDs in our logs and 429s under load. Can SE/infra help triage?
Maya (SE): Happy to. Are they using Hosted or Private?
Evan (AM): Hosted, region eu-central-1. They front with an F5 load balancer + nginx.
Ravi - Infra: I see their tenant showing 150->420 rps spikes; our rate-limiter trimmed to 200 -> producing 429s.
Customer: AcmeBank: We also noticed our app logs don't show any trace id fields even though we send `traceparent`.
Maya (SE): Can you paste a sanitized curl you're using and a snippet of the nginx location block?
Customer: (paste)
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "traceparent: 00-abc123..." \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
nginx location has only proxy_pass and X-Forwarded-For.
Maya (SE): Likely nginx not forwarding `traceparent`. Minimal fix: `proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent; proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $http_x_request_id;` Also some enterprise proxies lowercase headers; set both cases.
Ravi - Infra: For the 429s we can temporarily raise tenant throttle to 600rps for a 2-hour window while they ramp tests. Can approve if AE confirms.
Evan (AM): Approved. Please enact and tell customer to re-run load after nginx change.
Deploy Bot: quota-update: acmebank-poc throttle set 600rps until 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z by Ravi.
Customer: AcmeBank: Added headers, restarted nginx, now see `trace_id` in Redwood logs. 429s dropped after quota bump. Can you provide Splunk drain mapping to include `trace_id`?
Maya (SE): Yes. Example: include `trace_id` in event payload or set `attributes`: ["trace_id","request_id"] in drain config. I'll DM the small snippet and a one-paragraph security note.
Evan (AM): Great, follow-up meeting 30m to confirm metrics. Thanks everyone.
